intent: Create a four-frame 16:9 UI Motion storyboard that proves a setup flow through local interface states, exact typography, flat graphite line art, and one restrained semantic orange accent.

inputs.description: Repository reference used only for line weight, paper-white field, controlled gray, and hand-drawn restraint.

creative_routing.delivery_context: motion-design storyboard for a product walkthrough
creative_routing.design_priority: exact text, local state readability, typography hierarchy, and semantic accent ownership

scene.summary: A local interface setup flow shown as four independent 16:9 states.
scene.setting: warm-white UI field with charcoal outlines, restrained gray fills, and generous negative space

color.grade: neutral warm-white field with graphite lines
color.contrast: clear black-gray hierarchy with orange only on the active semantic target
color.saturation: near-monochrome except the restrained orange accent

style.medium: flat 2D graphite and clean vector-like line art

text_elements.placement: frame-01, left aligned in the primary title zone, one line
text_elements.typography: large bold Chinese sans serif, dominant first read, generous tracking

text_elements.placement: frame-02, centered inside the enlarged active button
text_elements.typography: medium semibold Chinese sans serif, one line, optically centered

text_elements.placement: frame-03, adjacent to the progress ring without crossing its active arc
text_elements.typography: bold numeral with smaller Chinese label on a shared baseline

text_elements.placement: frame-04, one-line result title aligned with the confirmation mark
text_elements.typography: large bold Chinese sans serif, balanced against the orange confirmation mark

continuity_locks: orange #FF6A2A owns only the active state

reference_assignments.use: line weight, paper-white field, controlled gray, hand-drawn restraint
reference_assignments.ignore: characters, location, props, panel content, exact layout, and all text

frames.story_moment: the viewer understands that setup begins here
frames.primary_action: one setup card becomes the dominant available action
frames.composition: one large setup card anchors center-left, the exact title owns a protected upper-left field, a faint four-node sequence rail recedes toward the right, and low-contrast point-grid construction stays at the margins; no full dashboard, no map, and all introductory or inactive elements remain charcoal or gray

hierarchy.l0_primary_focus: one dominant setup card with a folder-and-document action
l2_continuity: the next upload node appears only as a small preview
l3_ambient_scaffold: regular low-contrast point fields at the outer margins
hierarchy.calm_zone: protect the upper-left title field from routes, dots, and secondary cards
hierarchy.accent_owner: none in this introductory frame; every state remains charcoal or gray

frames.story_moment: the upload step becomes the selected action
frames.primary_action: a mouse pointer selects the enlarged upload button
frames.composition: the selected upload control becomes the only near-full-frame component; a source document card enters from the left, the previous setup edge is cropped at the far left, the next progress node is a faint preview at the far right, and point-grid construction remains quiet; orange appears only on the selected outline and pointer contact, with no hand cursor

hierarchy.l0_primary_focus: the enlarged selected upload control and pointer contact
l1_proof: one source document visibly entering the active control
l2_continuity: a cropped residue of the prior setup card
a faint next progress node on the shared sequence rail
l3_ambient_scaffold: one low-contrast motion arc behind the control
hierarchy.calm_zone: leave the upper-right field open so the active control reads without a dashboard surround
hierarchy.accent_owner: only the selected outline, current sequence node, and pointer-contact ticks use #FF6A2A

frames.story_moment: the system is visibly processing the uploaded material
frames.primary_action: the progress arc advances to 68 percent
frames.composition: a large progress ring and exact percentage dominate the frame; one uploaded-document proof sits beside the ring, a cropped upload residue remains at the left edge, a small completion preview sits at the right edge, and low-contrast point-grid motion passes behind them; only the completed arc is orange, all inactive marks stay gray

hierarchy.l0_primary_focus: the 68-percent progress ring and its completed orange arc
l1_proof: the exact processing label and percentage
one uploaded-document state linked to the ring
l2_continuity: the previous upload control survives as a cropped left-edge residue
the future completion node appears as a small right-edge preview
l3_ambient_scaffold: low-contrast regular point-grid motion behind the focal ring
hierarchy.calm_zone: keep the lower-right quadrant free of cards and dense dots
hierarchy.accent_owner: only the completed progress arc and current sequence node use #FF6A2A

frames.story_moment: the viewer understands that setup has succeeded
frames.primary_action: the result card changes to the completed state
frames.composition: one confirmation card and exact result title dominate center-right; the prior progress ring is cropped and lowered in contrast at the left edge, the shared sequence rail resolves into the final node, and sparse point-grid residue exits toward the bottom; orange belongs only to the confirmation mark and the final active edge

hierarchy.l0_primary_focus: the completed confirmation card and decisive check mark
l1_proof: the final sequence node visibly resolves
l2_continuity: the prior progress ring remains as a cropped low-contrast residue
the shared process rail terminates at the completed state
l3_ambient_scaffold: sparse point-grid residue leaving the frame
hierarchy.calm_zone: protect the upper-left and lower-right fields so the completion state has visual rest
hierarchy.accent_owner: only the confirmation mark and final active edge use #FF6A2A

must_preserve: layered L0-L3 information hierarchy with one dominant focal event per frame
exclude: equal-weight cards or equally dark detail across the whole frame
one isolated component floating in unexplained empty space
visible shot numbers, frame IDs, duration labels, review arrows or production annotations

quality_controls: main title stays dominant over auxiliary UI detail
inactive elements remain charcoal or gray
L0 remains readable at thumbnail scale while L2 and L3 recede
each frame preserves one calm zone and asymmetric density
no map motif outside a geography frame
